lines.zh: 我一动，整片地面都在陷。
lines.en: When I move, the whole floor sinks.

lines.zh: 这具身躯比山小不了多少。
lines.en: This body is not much smaller than a hill.
My foot falls and the rock splits.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，因为我不必快。
lines.en: I walk slowly because I need not hurry.

lines.zh: 熔岩在我脚下被踩得溅开。
lines.en: Lava splashes away beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我每挪一步，天就更红一点。
lines.en: Each step, the sky turns redder.
The terrain of the Nether does not stop me.
Old metal is embedded in my flesh.

lines.zh: 我一转身，柱林就断了一片。
lines.en: I turn and a stand of pillars breaks.

lines.zh: 我朝那座城的火光迈了一步。
lines.en: I take one step toward the burning city.

lines.zh: 我站着，背上的伤还在流火。
lines.en: I stand, fire still running from my back.

lines.zh: 我的头很低，眼睛却看得很远。
lines.en: My head hangs low, yet my eyes see far.

lines.zh: 这具身体不是自然长成的。
lines.en: This body did not grow naturally.
I wait for someone to come and die.
My breath makes the air burn.

lines.zh: 我背上的东西一直在动。
lines.en: The thing on my back keeps moving.

lines.zh: 金属块在我皮里咯咯响。
lines.en: Metal plates grind inside my hide.

lines.zh: 我张开手，掌心能放下一个人。
lines.en: I open a hand; a person could fit in the palm.

lines.zh: 我不属于这里，可我也不走。
lines.en: I do not belong here, and I do not leave.
I hear gunfire far off.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了半个平原。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the plain.
I wait, very quietly.
I lower my head; blood drips from my teeth.

lines.zh: 这一带被我一寸寸踩平。
lines.en: I have flattened this whole stretch.

lines.zh: 我的咆哮在胸腔里压着。
lines.en: A roar is pressed inside my chest.
I can rise at any moment.

lines.zh: 你这么小，也敢站在这里。
lines.en: So small, and still you stand here.
I lower my head and my shadow swallows you.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我看不懂。
lines.en: What you hold, I do not understand.
I will take your weapon apart first.

lines.zh: 你往左挪，我的头也跟着偏。
lines.en: You edge left and my head tilts after you.

lines.zh: 这一片世界，我打算收下。
lines.en: This world, I intend to take.
I have seen too many people looking up.

lines.zh: 你一喘，我就知道你在哪。
lines.en: One breath and I know where you are.
Either run or die.
I do not need to look; I can smell you.

lines.zh: 你手里那片铁，挡不住我的牙。
lines.en: That sliver of iron in your hand won't stop my teeth.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，像一个句号。
lines.en: You stand there like a full stop.
That did not even break my hide.
You dare touch me.
I step back half a pace and the ground collapses.
There is no pain in this body.
I have noted the wound you made.
The metal plates grind.
I lower my head to look at the wound.
This wound only makes me hasten.

lines.zh: 我的血落在地上，烧穿了石头。
lines.en: My blood burns through the stone.
You had better have another move.

lines.zh: 我嘴里只容得下一座城。
lines.en: Only a city would fill my mouth.
Try feeding a mountain.
I feed on this world.

lines.zh: 这点东西，连我一颗牙都塞不住。
lines.en: That would not fill one of my teeth.
Put it away; do not block my path.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，会先烧起来。
lines.en: What you hold will burn first.
I am not hungry; I want to destroy.
You are not even an appetizer.
I do not take what people offer.
Holding it up is laughable.

lines.zh: 你撞在我脚边，我没感觉到。
lines.en: You struck my foot; I did not feel it.
You were thrown far.

lines.zh: 我的脚跟碾过你刚站的地方。
lines.en: My heel grinds the spot you just left.

lines.zh: 这一撞，连我的皮都没动。
lines.en: That did not even shift my hide.

lines.zh: 你在我脚边，像一颗小石子。
lines.en: You're at my feet, like a pebble.
There is a new crater in the ground.

lines.zh: 你贴在我身上，像一粒沙。
lines.en: You press against me like a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 我的重量不是你能推的。
lines.en: My weight is not yours to push.
Closer, and I step down.
My step collapses the ledge.
I was made for destruction.
Such things are not in me.
Your question is too human.
I have only one thought.
Do not speak of it at my feet.

lines.zh: 这世界要被撞碎，不是被延续。
lines.en: This world is to be shattered, not continued.
I have no kin, only targets.
Not even the wind answers.

lines.zh: 我在等一个更大的声音。
lines.en: I am waiting for a louder sound.
Leave.
I pick up a whole ledge.
It crumbles to dust in my hand.

lines.zh: 我两根指头一夹，它就碎了。
lines.en: Two fingers pinch it and it crumbles.
I tear up a length of wall.
Argent blocks. I know them.

lines.zh: 我把它扔出去，砸塌一片。
lines.en: I throw it and a stretch collapses.

lines.zh: 太重了，连我都要用两只手。
lines.en: So heavy even I need both hands.
I press it into the ground.
I do not intend to give it back.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看它还在不在。
lines.en: I lift my hand to check it is still there.

lines.zh: 我看你从那堆碎石后面站出来。
lines.en: I see you step out from behind that rubble.
My eyes have settled on you.

lines.zh: 这一片地方，都是我的猎场。
lines.en: This whole place is my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我的手落下，你的天就黑了。
lines.en: My hand comes down and your sky goes black.
One step crushes you.
I smell the warmth on you.
My back is heating up.
First I will destroy your way out.
You stand there. Good.
I roar and the ground shakes.
This wound can wait.
My fist is already raised.

lines.zh: 你不会有机会跑第二次。
lines.en: You will not get a second chance to run.

lines.zh: 我等这一刻，等得骨头都响了。
lines.en: I've waited so long my bones creak.
My shadow presses ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我举拳的时候，云被撕开一道口。
lines.en: As I raise my fist, the clouds tear open.
You looked up. That is enough.

lines.zh: 我选中了这个世界，也选中你。
lines.en: I chose this world, and I choose you.

lines.zh: 我一步一步跟着，地都在陷。
lines.en: I follow step by step, and the ground sinks.
Wherever you run is my ground.
No hurry; my fist will wait.
I lift a foot to block your path.
Every time you look back, I am there.

lines.zh: 我推倒一堵墙，让你没处躲。
lines.en: I push a wall down so you cannot hide.
Lava runs along my footprints.
The further you run, the closer to my feet.
My roar makes you unsteady.

lines.zh: 我在算你还要多久倒下。
lines.en: I am counting how long until you fall.
This sky has turned red.

lines.zh: 我把手里的东西举起来。
lines.en: I raise what I am holding.
I have taken apart the road behind you.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿不动，我当你等死。
lines.en: Standing still there, I take you for dead already.
There is no light in my shadow.
I am one step away.
You are breathing harder than before.

lines.zh: 这里的柱子，我一碰就断。
lines.en: The pillars here break at my touch.
I lower my head, teeth downward.

lines.zh: 我呼出的热气把石头烤干了。
lines.en: My breath dries the stone as it passes.

lines.zh: 我的手拍下去，地陷了一层。
lines.en: My hand comes down and the ground drops a layer.

lines.zh: 这一拳，把石台打成碎片。
lines.en: This fist shatters the ledge.
I press you into the rock.

lines.zh: 我的脚踩下去，没有声音。
lines.en: My foot comes down without a sound.
The wind of my palm throws you.
My teeth close like two doors.

lines.zh: 这一击，是为了拆掉这个世界。
lines.en: This blow is to take this world apart.
You blocked it? I was not trying.

lines.zh: 我甩头，角扫过一排石柱。
lines.en: I swing my head; horns sweep a row of pillars.
You fly out and land by the lava.

lines.zh: 我按下去的拳头又抬起半寸。
lines.en: The fist I pressed down lifts half a block.

lines.zh: 我的拳头落地的声音很闷。
lines.en: My fist lands with a dull sound.
This one takes half a wall.

lines.zh: 你还能站起来，我很意外。
lines.en: You can still stand. I am surprised.
I raise my hand for the second.

lines.zh: 我一拳下去，你连影子都留不住。
lines.en: One punch and not even your shadow survives.

lines.zh: 我从地缝里升起来，很高。
lines.en: I rise from the fissure, very tall.
My horns break the rock layer first.

lines.zh: 第一眼看见的，是红色的天。
lines.en: The first thing I see is a red sky.

lines.zh: 我的背上有东西在生长。
lines.en: Something grows on my back.
The ground cannot hold me.
Argent fire lights me up.
When I stand straight, the clouds drop low.
Lava runs down off me.

lines.zh: 我记得自己是被造出来的。
lines.en: I remember being made.
I do not remember by whom.

lines.zh: 我的第一声吼，震塌了石柱。
lines.en: My first roar brings down pillars.

lines.zh: 这个世界比我记得的小。
lines.en: This world is smaller than I remember.

lines.zh: 我把手撑在地上，站了起来。
lines.en: I brace my hands and stand.

lines.zh: 影子先落下去，压住一片地。
lines.en: My shadow falls first, pinning the ground.
I know which way to go.
Toward the light.
Toward the living.
I lift my foot. The first step.
The ground begins to sink beneath me.
Whoever looks up first dies first.

lines.zh: 火对我不算什么，只是更亮。
lines.en: Fire is nothing to me, only brighter.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，砸出一个深坑。
lines.en: I fall from above and blast out a deep crater.

lines.zh: 水浇在我身上，变成蒸汽。
lines.en: Water hits me and turns to steam.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推得侧了一步。
lines.en: The blast shoves me one step sideways.

lines.zh: 有东西打进我的皮里，很浅。
lines.en: Something lodges in my hide, shallow.
A force wanders loose inside me.
I do not eat, yet this body empties.
Lightning strikes my horns, loud.
Not even lava below me now.
